Use case: identity-preserve. Create production SHIELD-BROKEN / STAGGERED full-body sprites for the Japanese shooting game Refrain, by changing the pose of the referenced existing characters. Strictly preserve each reference's exact chibi proportions, face design, hair color, eye color, clothing, footwear, accessories, line weight, cel shading and color palette. These are temporary vulnerable combat poses, NOT death, purification, celebration, sleep or an attack. They must read unmistakably as DOWN: head bowed forward, eyes mostly closed in fatigue, shoulders dropped, curved slumping torso, elbows slack, knees folded and body sagging in midair. Hands stay anatomically connected and both legs and shoes remain visible. No dramatic pain, blood, wounds, torn clothing, sexual framing or exposure. Modest normal game sprite view. No floor, ground shadow, platform or kneeling on a surface; they remain suspended in the game's aerial battlefield. Hair and clothing follow the slack body downward, not an attacking wind. No shield, magic circle, bright glow, streaks, sparks, text or UI; effects will be handled by the game. THREE-QUARTER VIEW facing the same direction as each reference (toward viewer's right for most), entire figure from crown to shoes in safe transparent margins. True transparent RGBA background, NO gray/white matte, checkerboard or background lighting. Clean standalone sprites, sharp edges with no colored halos. Keep heads at exactly the same size across the sheet; do not stretch the body to fill a cell.
Deliver a TWO-COLUMN ONE-ROW transparent sprite sheet, 1536x1024 landscape. Exactly TWO sprites, equal cells with generous empty gutter, no labels. Both are AKARI in the ivory gold-trimmed office sorceress coat, black trousers, navy pumps, white shirt, navy tie, lanyard, orange side ponytail with ivory-gold ribbon, dangling cyan ribbons. LEFT uses input1 main boss appearance (pale cyan blue eyes if a sliver is visible), clearly slumped sideways with head down and hands no longer clutching both knees; her phone hangs loosely beside her right thigh, knees bent together behind and below the body. RIGHT uses input2 midboss appearance (purple eyes if visible), less curled but visibly buckling forward, one slack hand over her bent knee and lowered phone in the other. Both retain the SAME outfit and proportions as their respective reference. No magical effects. NOT the alert phone-reading pose of the reference. The down pose needs a clearly new silhouette with lowered head and limp shoulders.
